Name: Change Farm Type
Author: hotbees
Description:
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
This mod has been developed for Stardew patch 1.6.

All strings are loaded on a low priority and [i]will[/i] be overwritten by most other mods. I chose to do this to avoid overwriting any important changes since an NPC accidentally calling eg. your ranch a farm isn't the worst thing in the world. I intend to do mod-specific patches in future for mods such as SVE, and requests are welcome.

[b][size=5]Configuration[/size][/b]
This mod works best with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] so you can easily configure the options in game.
You can also directly edit the config.json file created by SMAPI in the mod folder.

There are three configuration options offered:
[list]
[*][b]FarmNameSuffix[/b]: This is the word added to the end of your farm's name, such as in "Honeycomb [u]Farm[/u]".
[list]
[*][b]Default[/b]: [i]Farm[/i]
[/list][*][b]FarmNoun[/b]: This is the word NPCs use to refer to your farm in dialogue, for example, "How are things going on the [u]farm[/u]?".
[list]
[*][b]Default[/b]: [i]farm[/i]
[*][size=2][i]Note: This should be lowercase. The mod will capitalize it correctly where appropriate.[/i][/size]
[/list][*][b]Preposition[/b]: The preposition used in dialogue, for example, "How are things going [u]on[/u] the farm?".
[list]
[*][b]Default[/b]: [i]on[/i]
[/list][/list]
[size=5][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
[list]
